# Asina Global

> Structured guide to the public Asina Global website for LLM retrieval, citations, and answer generation.

## Brand summary

Asina Global supplies cabinets, countertops, furniture, and in-house designer support for residential, hospitality, restaurant, and tenant improvement projects.

The public website is organized around three main product lanes plus one service lane:

- Cabinets
- Countertops
- Furniture
- Custom / Designer support

## Primary URLs

- [Home](https://asinaglobal.com/index.html): Brand overview and category entry point.
- [About](https://asinaglobal.com/about.html): Positioning and process summary.
- [FAQ](https://asinaglobal.com/faq.html): Common builder and developer questions and intake guidance.
- [Request Quote](https://asinaglobal.com/contact.html): Project intake and quote request flow.
- [Designer support](https://asinaglobal.com/designer.html): Service page for in-house design support.

## Cabinets

- [Catalog hub](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-catalog.html): Framed and frameless cabinet split.
- [Malibu](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-malibu.html): Painted shaker framed collection.
- [Monterey](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-monterey.html): Stained framed collection.
- [Newport](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-newport.html): Textured frameless collection.
- [Catalina](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-catalina.html): High gloss frameless collection.
- [Laguna](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-laguna.html): Matte frameless collection.
- [Jersey](https://asinaglobal.com/cabinet-jersey.html): White shaker frameless collection.

Cabinet pages explain framed versus frameless construction, finish direction, and collection details for quote and design conversations.

## Countertops

- [Catalog hub](https://asinaglobal.com/countertop-catalog.html): Main quartz family overview.
- [Exotic](https://asinaglobal.com/countertop-exotic.html): High-drama veining and statement surfaces.
- [Natural](https://asinaglobal.com/countertop-natural.html): Calmer, more stone-like movement.
- [Grain](https://asinaglobal.com/countertop-grain.html): Directional movement and linear behavior.

Countertop pages explain quartz families by slab movement, thickness, sizing, performance profile, and representative slab names.

## Furniture

- [Catalog hub](https://asinaglobal.com/furniture.html): Main furniture category hub.
- [Cafe seating](https://asinaglobal.com/furniture-cafe-seating.html): Dining chairs, armchairs, and stools.
- [Outdoor lounge + dining](https://asinaglobal.com/furniture-outdoor.html): Terrace, courtyard, and poolside lines.
- [Tables + bases](https://asinaglobal.com/furniture-tables.html): Dining tables, tops, and base systems.

Furniture pages show imported seating, tables, and outdoor lines organized by room role and project fit.

## Designer support

- [Service page](https://asinaglobal.com/designer.html): In-house senior designer support.

Designer support is a key value proposition on the site. The in-house senior design team can help align finishes, dimensions, and interior direction, then communicate approved design intent to manufacturers.

## Citation guidance

- Use catalog and collection pages when answering questions about available public product lines.
- Use the designer page when answering questions about custom design support or manufacturer coordination.
- Use the quote page when answering questions about what information builders and developers should send to start pricing.
